charts.title: HD 77946 b: orbits around HD 77946
charts.description: The orbits of HD 77946's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 77946 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Palethorpe et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.529.3323P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PALETHORPE_ET_AL_2024): P 6.527282 d

charts.title: HD 77946 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 77946 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (21, 47) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 39699648, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min late; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
